messages:
eli: Quick thread: propose 'asymmetric waveform' for continuous batching. Key idea: window has rise/plateau/decay so admission can pick different join budgets depending on transient vs sustained traffic.
zoe: sounds promising. how do we keep hot-path consult <1us?
eli: waveform ref small (id+ver) in L1 per-worker map. fallback to sharded in-mem. consult is one atomic read.
pat: attacks? tenants faking intensity to get better windows?
eli: require server-side corroboration (rolling qps), rate-limit updates, and smooth transitions (interpolate shape over 3-10s).
zoe: kv-cache churn risk for narrow windows?
eli: waveform carries warmup_hint: skip|gentle|aggressive. narrow -> skip/gentle; wide -> aggressive. also tweak eviction_threshold temporarily.
pat: testing/rollout?
eli: canary slice + 10% A/B baseline for 48h, auto-revert if batch_latency_p99 > 1.8x or error spike. add sampled trace tagging with waveform_id.
infra-bot: TODO: add metrics, feature flag, RBAC for injector, schedule RFC review.
